title: Pay the construction industry training levy
what: As the owner of a construction project, pay the building and construction industry training levy (a share of the project's value) before construction work starts.

laws.title: Building and Construction Industry Training Fund and Levy Collection Act 1990 (WA)

sources.title: Building and Construction Industry Training Fund and Levy Collection Act 1990 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: Every project owner shall — (a) before commencing any construction work for which a permit is required, pay to a collection agency the levy in respect of that construction work based on the value of the construction work estimated under Schedule 2
